**Finding: compliant — no redline proposed.**

The agreement contains no MFN obligation running against Clear Capital. Compensation is fixed solely by each Statement of Work on a time-and-materials basis (§ 3(a)), billing and rate changes are handled in § 3(b), and targeted searches for "most favoured/favored nation", "no less favorable", best-pricing, right-to-match, and comparable-customer language returned nothing anywhere in the document. Section 1 (purpose/engagement) likewise imposes no obligation to offer RadialSpark terms given to third parties or to match third-party offers.

This sits at the **preferred** position ("Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor"). Note for the file: there is also no MFN in our favour — welcome if we can get one in a Statement of Work, but its absence is not a deviation under this rule.
